thread:
maria: Quick question 11 were doing SIEM export for a vuln triage and need temporary access to KMS-encrypted raw logs. Proposal: timeboxed export (2h), access via KMS Grant to the forensic proxy + strict copy policy. Thoughts?
samir: +1 to timebox. Prefer Grants over changing CMK policy for short ops. Grants can be revoked and are auditable. Also require encryption-context on decrypts so we can prove purpose.
frank-secops: Agree Grants are cleaner. Two concerns: (1) preventing accidental downstream retention (analysts saving raw files outside ephemeral host) and (2) ensuring CloudTrail surfaces kms:Decrypt with EncryptionContext. We should add a DLP check and a signed-url-only delivery for redacted artifacts.
claire: For the analyst path I suggest this flow: snapshot -> write to s3://forensic-ephemeral/<ticket>/raw.enc -> create KMS Grant to log-proxy principal with constraint on encryption-context: {"ticket":"SEC-2024-78"} -> analyst connects to bastion workstation with ephemeral disk -> download/decrypt -> run triage -> push scrubbed output to s3://siem-ingest/redacted/<ticket>/ -> signed URL for SIEM team.
maria: Can someone paste an example KMS Grant CLI? I can add to runbook.
samir: Example grant (aws kms create-grant):
```
aws kms create-grant \
  --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234 \
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/log-proxy \
  --operations Decrypt \
  --constraints EncryptionContextSubset={"ticket":"SEC-2024-78"}
```

samir: Important: use GrantToken in sts flow if we do interim perms. Also add kms:ViaService in CMK policy to block direct user decrypts.
frank-secops: On retention: do not change retention metadata on the raw snapshot. We must set object tags: retention=incident-ephemeral and lifecycle rule to expire after 7d. But access window is 2h; lifecycle is a safety net.
claire: We'll enforce ephemeral workstation via Session Manager and SSM doc that blocks uploading artifacts to external S3. Also enable EBS encryption with no snapshot allowed.
maria: Compliance asked to see proof-of-use. Can we log the encryption-context values into our security-audit index and make a specific query for ticket SEC-2024-78?
frank-secops: Yes. CloudTrail records KMS events but encryption-context isn't always included in CloudTrail detail. Add a small proxy shim (log-proxy) that logs request metadata to the security-audit index before performing decrypt; include the encryption-context and principal.
samir: Also add an automated post-condition: after revoke, run a verification job that queries CloudTrail and S3 access logs for any GETs outside the ephemeral host IP range. Emit an alert if found.
claire: Ops-bot, create incident SEC-2024-78 and provision ephemeral bucket + role (2h TTL).
audit-bot: Incident SEC-2024-78 created. Resources provisioned: s3://forensic-ephemeral/SEC-2024-78/, role forensic-jump-SEC-2024-78 (expires 2h).
maria: Perfect. I'll update the runbook with Grant CLI and the post-revoke verification steps. Please review PR once I send it.
frank-secops: One more nit: ensure we don't allow PutObjectTagging or s3:PutObjectRetention from the ephemeral role. That prevents altering retention metadata during triage.
samir: Good call. Deny those actions explicitly in the role policy.
maria: Thanks team, will ping compliance for signoff after PR.
